mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_key AS ownerKey, name, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM chartbook WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND create_idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
SELECT id, owner_key AS ownerKey, name, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM chartbook WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id
SELECT id, owner_key AS ownerKey, name, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM chartbook WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND id = #{chartbookId}

SELECT d.id FROM diagram d JOIN chartbook c ON c.id = d.chartbook_id AND c.owner_key = #{ownerKey} WHERE d.chartbook_id = #{chartbookId} AND d.user_id = #{ownerKey} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.id
mapper.update: UPDATE chartbook SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{chartbookId} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE chartbook SET status = 'ARCHIVED' WHERE id = #{chartbookId} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE diagram SET chartbook_id = NULL WHERE user_id = #{ownerKey} AND chartbook_id = #{chartbookId} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE diagram d JOIN chartbook c ON c.id = #{chartbookId} AND c.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' SET d.chartbook_id = c.id WHERE d.id = #{diagramId} AND d.user_id = #{ownerKey} AND d.deleted = 0
UPDATE diagram SET chartbook_id = NULL WHERE id = #{diagramId} AND user_id = #{ownerKey} AND deleted = 0 AND chartbook_id IS NOT NULL
